note: San Marino keeps an open border with Italy and no immigration control, reached only through Italy: a visitor meets the EU's common list (the eu1806 list).

sources.title: Wikipedia, Schengen Area: territories and European microstates
sources.said: The Republic of San Marino maintains an entirely open border with Italy, functioning as a de facto member of the Schengen Area despite not being a formal signatory of the agreement.
